column1: # Hand-curated, NOT written by generate_gtdb_organism_table.py. One row per GTDB species that must never receive an AMRFinderPlus --organism; the reason is copied into the audit TSV. Checked against GTDB release r232 and the AMRFinderPlus database 2026-01-21.1.

column2: GTDB merges B. pseudomallei into its B. mallei species, but AMRFinderPlus curates B. mallei and B. pseudomallei as two organisms with different point-mutation lists; the GTDB call cannot tell which of the two this isolate is, so naming either would assert a species the data do not support
